title: Irrigation expansion has raised Gujarat’s agricultural resilience, with irrigated area outpacing rainfed area across the state’s core production base
subtitle: Paired comparison dashboard showing that Gujarat’s cultivated system is anchored by a larger irrigated footprint than rainfed dependence, supporting more stable production and a stronger base for water-productivity intervention.

chart.annotation: The cultivated base is majority irrigated, showing stronger production stability than a rainfed-led system.

insights.text: **Irrigated area** accounts for **58%** of cultivated area, exceeding the **42%** in rainfed area.
The **58% / 42%** split shows Gujarat’s production base rests more on managed water access than on rainfall alone.
This majority-irrigated footprint makes water-efficiency, crop-water productivity, and farmer-income interventions easier to scale through existing irrigation coverage.
